text: For the leader; "upon the gittith." [1] Of Asaph.
I Sing joyfully to God our strength; [AA]raise loud shouts to the God of Jacob!
Take up a melody, sound the timbrel,the pleasant lyre with a harp.
t[2]Blow the shofar at the new moon,at the full moon, on our solemn feast. [AB]
For this is a law for Israel,an edict of the God of Jacob, [AC]
He made it a decree for Josephwhen he came out of the land of Egypt.
II [3]I heard a tongue I did not know:"I removed his shoulder from the burden; [4]his hands moved away from the basket. [5] [AD]
In distress you called and I rescued you;I answered you in secret with thunder;At the waters of Meribah [6] I tested you: [AE]
'Listen, my people, I will testify against you SelahIf only you will listen to me, Israel! [AF]
There shall be no foreign god among you; [7] [AG]you shall not bow down to an alien god.
'I am the Lord your God,who brought you up from the land of Egypt.Open wide your mouth that I may fill it.'
But my people did not listen to my words;Israel would not submit to me.
So I thrust them away to the hardness of their heart;'Let them walk in their own machinations.' [AH]
O that my people would listen to me,that Israel would walk in my ways, [AI]
In a moment I would humble their foes,and turn back my hand against their oppressors. [AJ]
Those who hate the Lord will try flattering him,but their fate is fixed forever.
But Israel I will feed with the finest wheat,I will satisfy them with honey from the rock." [AK]
